note: Superior NF campground on Iron Lake, ~38 mi up the Gunflint Trail from Grand Marais and 2 mi in on narrow gravel County Road 92, in young forest regrown after the 2007 Ham Lake Fire. Sites 3 and 4 sit on the lakeshore, with a grassy path down to the water; the others are back in the trees. Boats are carried down; Iron Lake is an entry point to the Boundary Waters. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 232427 + FS page read: rate $24 -> $26 (rec.gov 2026/2027; FS page still says $24), extra vehicle $12, 9 people max; 7 sites (site 1 FCFS), RV limits 20-40 ft (40 kept), no electric, vault + drinking water; season 05-08..10-04 (FS), booking season 05-07..10-10. Lakefront kept on sites 3 and 4 (photos + imagery). Phone added.
flags: Waterfront: lakefront kept on two sites, caveat in the note. Site 003 (48.06720,-90.61578, 40 ft) is ~28 m from Iron Lake; its rec.gov photo shows a grassy path through a gap in the shrubs straight down to the water. Site 004 (48.06716,-90.61534, 40 ft) has its pad ~15-20 m from shore on open bedrock and grass, the lake in view over low shrubs. Both are reservable nightly sites. Sites 005, 006, 007 are 35-60 m back in young aspen/birch with no water in their photos; 001 and 002 are 100 m+ back.
Fees: stored $24 -> $26. recreation.gov's rate table charges $26 for the 2026 and 2027 seasons; the FS page still reads 'Single Site: $24 per night' (stale).

Rig wording: the FS page says 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderately sized vehicle, some may not be suitable for an RV.' recreation.gov's catalog (same agency) permits RVs to 40 ft at sites 1, 3, 4 and 6 and 30 ft at 5 and 7, which outranks the wording; only site 2 (20 ft) is too short. No drop.
